QuestInfo.name: The Sleeping Temple
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the #bInsignificant Being#k in front of the temple.
QuestInfo.1: According to the Insignificant Being, you can get the crystals from the monsters in the temple. He is worried that the monsters may have been affected by the crystals, so he wants 10 Tauromacis Bloods to cleanse them.\r\n\r\n#questorder1##i4034072:# #t4034072:# #c4034072# / 10
QuestInfo.2: You brought all the purifying materials. Time for the crystals.

0.0: Why have you come to the Cursed Temple...\r\n#L0##bI'm here for the crystal used to make the Light Barrier. The Rememberer said you'd know where the crystal is.#l\n#k
0.1: You can get the crystal in this crumbled temple, but...\r\n#L0##bBut?#l\n#k
0.2: I am certain the crystal has been corrupted by the monsters within. You will need to cleanse them before you can take them.

yes.0: Hunt Tauromacises and bring me #b10 Tauromacis's Bloods#k.

no.0: You must not remove the crystals without cleansing them. You could spread the evil, and no one wants that.

1.0: Did you get the Tauromacis Blood that I asked for?

yes.0: Good. Now you may retrieve the crystal safely.

1.1: Crystals? You doing an experiment, too? Hold on a second.
